newsitem.title: GERMANY: German entrepreneur hurt by video-bomb.
newsitem.headline: German entrepreneur hurt by video-bomb.

text.p: A 30-year-old entrepreneur in the western German town of Trier was seriously injured on Saturday by a bomb concealed inside a video cassette box which had been mailed to him, police said.
The bomb went off when the man removed adhesive tape sealing the box, and opened it. He was taken to hospital with injuries to his hands, arms and abdomen, while his partner was slightly injured.
Police said the package had been posted in France. They gave no indication of a probable motive but said there was no reason to believe the attack was political.
